# Grid tables

## Header, footer and alignment

+-----------+-----------+-----------+
| Item      | Quantity  | Price     |
+:==========+:=========:+==========:+
| Tea       | 2         | 12.00     |
+-----------+-----------+-----------+
| Coffee    | 1         | 8.00      |
+===========+===========+===========+
| Total                 | 20.00     |
+===========+===========+===========+

## Spanning cells

+-------+-------+-------+
| Wide cell     | Tall  |
+-------+-------+       +
| Left  | Mid   | cell  |
+       +-------+-------+
| cell  | Wide again    |
+-------+-------+-------+

## Blocks inside cells

+-----------------------+-----------------------+
| **Rich** *text*       | - First item          |
| and `inline code`     | - Second item         |
|                       |                       |
| Another paragraph     | > A quote             |
+-----------------------+-----------------------+
